name: CortIQ
description: CortIQ is a web analytics platform that classifies AI traffic into training crawlers, agentic fetches and citation crawlers, alongside consent-first visitor analytics, heatmaps, form analytics and a built-in consent banner. EU-hosted.

capabilities.description: Ingest page views, clicks, custom events, and form interactions from any website
Detect and classify AI crawlers and agents visiting a website (by user agent, plus browser signals for in-browser agents), including agent journeys
Query aggregated analytics read-only via the REST API or the MCP server: traffic sources, device breakdown, top pages, AI agent sessions, heatmap data
Retrieve click heatmap data for any tracked page, segmented by device type
